title: Learning More Than You Can Know: Introductory Education Produces Overly Expansive Self-Assessments of Knowledge
main_or_robustness: main (classroom field studies and online experiments)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Studies 1-2 (finance or psychology-and-law class vs. control class, start vs. end of semester)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: two-group, two-period comparison (lm(spe ~ session*cond)) with one common treatment period; not staggered, no unit FE

eligible_reason: Not staggered. Studies 1-2 compare an introductory class with a control class at the start and end of one semester (a single 2x2 comparison); Studies 3-4 are randomized experiments.
design_notes: R scripts per study (OC_Edu_FinanceMHR.R, OC_Edu_PsychLaw.R, OC_Edu_Experiment*.R, OC_Edu_Fit.R) with lm/ANOVA and mediation.
estimators_reported: OLS / ANOVA with session x condition interaction
data_files_note: Survey data collected by the authors; raw and cleaned files shipped.
screener_notes: Published text confirms classroom and experimental design. Not a near miss.
